artifacts.enantiomorph:
TACHYONICA

Fragment of the Epic Poem
Recovered from the Future (6/24/14, 2:10 PM)
Tuesday, night before waking — van, on way to Zehnder's




— System, the last days of
Tachyon, ember of the latter day race of man,
and the omission of dormant registers, how
they swallowed dim threshold on the vacant address,
settled innumerable impressions to still water
deep; how no one sent the cold filament
beneath a held breath, with no purchase
of time's stopped mouth, on standing still
to cede them nothing, to effect a remaining,
in—in to familiar, near dark, a fullness of the untold;
and how the Tachyon went without utterance
to the hollow of the archive's locked silence; how
his unspent life refused a way to wait
down the sealed corridors in time
that led to an inhabitable pause. — System—

—

Night before waking: no one
stands outside closed vaults, dust
settles on bare hands, shut eyelids
hold nothing of the temperature of refusal—

——
